prompt.name: Submarine (early 20th century)
prompt.look: An early 20th century submarine running on the surface: a long, narrow cigar-shaped steel hull in dark grey riding low, a rounded bow, a tapered stern with a small propeller guard and rudder fin, a small conning tower amidships with a thin raised periscope, a low flat deck with a small deck gun forward of the tower, and a short flag staff. A broad horizontal band is painted along the middle of the hull side.
prompt.team_area: the broad band along the hull side
prompt.running_gear: The whole hull sits above one perfectly straight, horizontal waterline that is the bottom edge of the drawing. The conning tower and periscope are upright and the bow points right, above the line.
prompt.identity: the same hull, bow, stern fin, conning tower, periscope, deck gun, flag staff and red band
prompt.damage_gear: a dented conning tower and a bent periscope
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a split hull plate, a snapped periscope and a crumpled bow

recoil, muzzle flash and smoke built in code
